svg.title: W3NCY? contribution farm — day edition
svg.desc: Retro animated farm representing 67 public GitHub contributions across 8 active days as of 2026-11-01. Each cow marks one actual active calendar day. The three animated UFOs, chickens, sheep, rabbit, farmhouse, trees and fences are decorative. This is a dated snapshot, not a live calendar.
